jules: alert from KMS audit for private cluster 'eu-onprem' 501: lots of Decrypt calls from serviceAccount:infra:ci-runner between 07:14-07:17 UTC. can someone take a quick look?
kevin: paste an example log line?
jules: `2026-03-21T07:14:33Z KMSDecrypt key=projects/priv-kms/keys/p-rw-7 caller=serviceAccount:infra:ci-runner@infra`
nora: that SA shouldn't have decrypt rights. check recent clusterrolebinding changes.
kevin: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 5` shows `ad-hoc-ci-crb` created at 07:12 by ci-runner-job.
ops-oncall: recommend immediate containment: 1) revoke ci-runner secrets, 2) delete the CRB, 3) apply temporary namespace egress deny netpol, 4) capture KMS + kube audit for timeline.
nora: commands: `kubectl delete secret $(kubectl get sa ci-runner -n infra -o jsonpath='{.secrets[0].name}') -n infra` and `kubectl delete clusterrolebinding ad-hoc-ci-crb`
kevin: applying netpol snippet now to block all egress from infra ns except to internal proxies.
ops-oncall: netpol applied, decrypt traffic dropped to baseline within 40s. creating incident ticket SEC-2026-7001.
jules: quick root cause: CI job used elevated token and pipeline template accidentally created CRB. we need CI-side RBAC gating.
kevin: proposed fixes: - add OPA policy to reject CRB/ClusterRole creation from CI tokens, - KMS key IAM condition to require "request.resource.name" pattern and namespace label, - alert rule for kms.decrypt spikes in private clusters.
nora: add an automated fallback to playbook: netpol + SA revocation + evidence collection. I'll draft a PR for the OPA gate and the playbook changes.
guard-bot: attached audit export to SEC-2026-7001 and flagged for follow-up.
ops-oncall: mitigation confirmed. recommend we discuss default egress-deny for private clusters in next infra-sec sync; it's a larger change but would limit blast radius.
jules: thanks all. owners: nora (rbac + ci), kevin (network playbook), jules (kms audit). closing for now, will add postmortem tasks to the ticket. :thumbsup:
